title: Calculations with simple electronics formulas

spans.text: Use Ohm's law V=I×R, power P=V×I, and divider formula Vout=Vin×Rbottom/(Rtop+Rbottom). Convert units first: 1 kΩ = 1000 Ω and 1 mA = 0.001 A.
At 12 V across 6 Ω, I=V/R=2 A and P=V×I=24 W. A divider with equal resistors gives half the input voltage; leave margin for resistor power limits.
